name: Liquid Gooey
summary: Liquid effect library for React where touching pieces merge like goo and morph like jelly while text stays crisp.
description: A React library of liquid gooey effects: pieces that merge and morph when they touch, with text and images kept crisp through the blend. The original site gooey.jakubantalik.com is now a move notice pointing to libraries.dev/gooey, which carries the playground, installation and usage; the npm package liquid-gooey is unchanged.
contains: liquid gooey effects for React: pieces merge and morph on touch
text and images stay crisp through the blend
distributed as the liquid-gooey npm package
playground, installation and usage on the new home
original domain now redirects to libraries.dev/gooey
